notes: damage is per affected cell per use (beams/drills: per tick). radiusCells uses linear falloff to 50% at the edge (explosives fall to 0%). price is per purchase; consumables add 'stack' charges per purchase. knockback is the impulse (m/s) applied to players at the blast centre; >= ragdollThreshold puts them into ragdoll. Tuned with Tools/balance_sim.py. Guns with speed > 0 fire physics bullets: gravity (x normal), bounces (ricochets; every impact damages), restitution (speed kept per bounce), spreadDeg (cone), bulletSize (visual m), lifeS; automatic = hold to fire. Bullet guns were tuned by hand (Nov 2026) for ~1.5-2x the old hitscan output; balance_sim.py doesn't model bounces yet. Streak items (big moves) are bought once and recharge: 'recharge' is the cooldown in seconds between uses.

tools.name: Aqua Spade
tools.desc: Wide scoops. Great on the soft crust.

tools.name: Gecko Gloves
tools.desc: Passive: double climb stamina, 40% faster climbing.

tools.name: Boing Goo Gun

tools.name: Fizz Grenade
tools.desc: Pull, throw, boom. 5 per pack.

tools.name: Warp Kunai
tools.desc: Throw it and teleport to wherever it sticks. On a wall you hang right where it hit.

tools.name: Gel Sledge

tools.name: Goo Bomb

tools.name: Zip Tether
tools.desc: Swing like a spider. Hold Q (PC) / Swing (mobile) / empty off-hand trigger (VR); jump reels in, let go to fling.

tools.name: Saw Yo-yo

tools.name: Chain Whip
tools.desc: Lash anything within 9 m: rips a chunk out and yanks you toward it. Chain it with swinging.

tools.name: Swirl Drill

tools.name: Pop Stick
tools.desc: Long fuse, big pop. 4 per pack.

tools.name: Spray Blaster
tools.desc: Two-handed. Eight bouncy pellets that ricochet twice.

tools.name: Sky Beam
tools.desc: Continuous beam. Mine from a distance.

tools.name: Ripple Disc

tools.name: Chain Zapper

tools.name: Firework Launcher

tools.name: Hop Boots
tools.desc: Double jump and a boost dash off walls.

tools.name: Fizzy Barrel

tools.name: Thumper
tools.desc: Two-handed. Rattles through magma.

tools.name: Pixel Charge

tools.desc: Detonates all of your placed Pixel Charges.

tools.name: Cloud Pack
tools.desc: Hold to fly. 6 seconds of fuel, recharges on contact.

tools.name: Bubble Gatling
tools.desc: Two-handed. 25 bubbles a second that skip off whatever they hit.

tools.name: Pinball Popper
tools.desc: Hold to spray bouncy balls. Each one ricochets up to 5 times.

tools.name: Bloom Mortar

tools.name: Magnet Glove

tools.name: Drill Torpedo

tools.name: Aurora Cutter

tools.name: Bloop Launcher
